_comment: Talking to people, when the player's AI is on (docs/ai-integration.md, "Talking to people"). Three kinds of line:
chat.fact.*, chat.deal.*: the fact sheet the AI is given with every turn, the only facts it may use. Written to the
AI, not to the player; one fact a line. {price:money} and the like are filled as everywhere.
chat.stage.*: what happens, sent as the player's turn in [brackets] (the AI answers it): {thing} is what is talked about.
chat.ui.*: the words of the talk window and panel.
chat.offer_words: words that make a number in what the player types an offer (with a currency sign or k it is one anyway).
chat.agree_words: phrases that, anywhere in the player's line, take the price as it stands; chat.agree_alone: words that do
it as the whole line; chat.agree_not: words that make a line no agreement ("I never agreed"); a question never agrees.
chat.unit_words: words that, after a number, make it a measure and not money ("5k miles", "283 cubes"). chat.deal.shake, chat.deal.held, chat.fact.price_warning, chat.ui.buy: {price}.
chat.place.*: where the talk is, for the prompt's {place}. chat.sex.*: {sex}.
chat.section: how a section of the fact sheet is headed, {heading} one of chat.section.* (now, you: a rival's own facts,
thing: what is talked about, build: what is on that car, your_car: what is on a rival's own car, lot, races: with the
player, rival_races: with other racers, memories, said, deal; feeling: how they feel about the player, events: what
happened between them, earlier: the start of a long talk summed up).
chat.fact.feeling.sore, cool, warm, friendly: how the person feels about the player (-2, -1, +1, +2; nothing at 0).
chat.fact.events heads chat.fact.event.<kind>: {when}, {what} (the car or part), {amount} (bought, sold: the price;
offered, asked: the player's last offer that came to nothing); kinds bought, sold, offered, asked, insulted, beaten,
beat_player, pink_lost (the player won their car), pink_won.
chat.fact.build: heads a car's parts; build_part: {group} (the shop's shelf), {part}, {count} (build_count: {count}, or
nothing for one), {condition}, {origin} (build_stock or build_aftermarket for the engine's parts, else nothing);
build_many: a kind of many parts as one line, {group}, {count}, {condition} (the worst), {origin} (build_stock_all or nothing).
chat.fact.player and chat.fact.rival also {standing} (the reputation in words); player_car: {player}, {car} (what they drive). town_line: {when},
{text}. news_line: {when}, {headline}, {text}. market_car: {car}, {price}, {condition}, {mileage}, {where} (market_paper or
market_dealer). Headings also player_car (a rival's look at the player's car), market, town, news.
chat.fact.lot_price_warning: added when a salesman going over his lot named a price that is no car's on it.
chat.fact.car: {car}, {year}, {price}. car_engine: {engine}. car_power: {power} (hp). car_condition: {condition}, {label},
{mileage}. car_history: {history}. ad: {ad}. on_sale: {days}. part: {part}, {group}, {condition}, {price}.
lot: {count}. lot_car: {year}, {car}, {price}, {condition}, {engine}, {mileage}. rival: {name}, {nickname}, {age}, {wins}, {losses}, {reputation}.
rival_car, rival_grudge: {car}. races: {count}, {won} (by the person), {lost}. race_won, race_lost: {when}, {kind}, {pink}.
rival_race_won, rival_race_lost: {when}, {other}, {kind}, {car} (the loser's), {pink}, {wreck}. memory: {when}, {text}.
said_line: {text}. price, price_down: {price}, {asked}. chat.deal.*: {offer}, {price}. today: {date}. player: {player},
{wins}, {losses}, {reputation}. chat.when.days: {days}. chat.transcript.*: {name}, {text}.
The buyer who answered the player's own ad (the player sells): chat.place.buyer_phone; chat.stage.buyer_phone {thing},
{player}; chat.fact.buyer_car as chat.fact.car ({price} what the ad asks); chat.fact.offer, offer_up {price} the offer
now, {asked} the first; chat.deal.buyer.* {offer} what the player asked, {price} the offer after; chat.fact.offer_warning,
chat.deal.buyer.held, chat.ui.sell, chat.ui.offer_now {price}; chat.ui.offer_up {asked}. chat.ask_words: words that,
with chat.offer_words, make a number the player types a price asked of a buyer ("I want 1500").

lines.chat.place.phone: You are on the telephone at home: the player has called about your ad in the paper.
lines.chat.place.buyer_phone: You are on the telephone at home. You answered the player's ad in the paper and offered to buy their car; now the player has called you back.
lines.chat.place.lot: You are on your car lot, where you sell cars; the player is a customer walking round it.
lines.chat.place.curb: You are at the curb in front of your house, where the car stands; the player has come to see it.
lines.chat.place.diner: You are at the diner, where the street racers meet; the player has come over to your table.
lines.chat.section.player_car: The player's car, as you have seen it
lines.chat.section.market: Other cars for sale in town
lines.chat.section.memories: What you remember of the player
lines.chat.section.feeling: How you feel about the player
lines.chat.section.events: What happened between you and the player
lines.chat.section.earlier: Earlier in this talk, in short (your notes: where a price differs, the deal below is right)
lines.chat.place.cruise: You are in your car on the street at night, pulled up beside the player's car, engines running.
lines.chat.stage.phone: [Your telephone rings at home. You pick up; the caller is asking about the {thing} you advertised. Answer the phone as yourself.]
lines.chat.stage.buyer_phone: [Your telephone rings at home. It is {player}, calling back about the {thing} you offered to buy out of the paper. Answer the phone as yourself.]
lines.chat.stage.lot: [A customer walks onto your lot. Go over, welcome them, and talk up what you have on the lot.]
lines.chat.stage.lot_car: [A customer walks onto your lot and stops at the {thing}. Go over and start selling it.]
lines.chat.stage.curb: [The player has come round to your place to look at the {thing}. You come out to meet them.]
lines.chat.stage.diner: [The player comes over to your table at the diner.]
lines.chat.stage.cruise: [You have pulled up beside the player's car. They lean out of the window to talk.]
lines.chat.stage.picked: [The customer goes over to the {thing} and looks it over. Go on about it, without being asked.]
lines.chat.stage.picked_again: [The customer comes back to the {thing}, which you already talked about. Say something new about it, not what you said before.]
lines.chat.fact.player: The one you are talking to is {player}, a street racer in town: {standing} ({wins} wins, {losses} losses).
lines.chat.fact.town: What people are saying around town, the newest first (you heard it; it may be gossip):
lines.chat.fact.news: In the local paper lately, the newest first:
lines.chat.fact.market: Other cars for sale in town right now, the most like this one first (their prices are theirs, never this one's):
lines.chat.fact.buyer_car: The player's car you want to buy: a {year} {car}; their ad asks {price:money}. You are the buyer, not the seller.
lines.chat.fact.car_modified: It has been worked on: not as it left the factory.
lines.chat.fact.car_original: It is as it left the factory, nothing changed.
lines.chat.fact.ad: The ad in the paper says: {ad}
lines.chat.fact.on_sale: It has been for sale {days} days.
lines.chat.fact.lot: On your lot ({count} cars), the dearest first:
lines.chat.fact.lot_price_warning: You just named a price that is no car's on your lot: never make one up. Say only the prices above, in figures.
lines.chat.fact.build: Part by part, as it is now:
lines.chat.fact.build_stock_all: , all as they came from the factory
lines.chat.fact.build_stock: , as it came from the factory
lines.chat.fact.build_aftermarket: , not the factory's: put on since
lines.chat.fact.lot_empty: Your lot is empty right now.
lines.chat.fact.rival: You are {name} "{nickname}", {age}, a street racer: {standing} on the street ({wins} wins, {losses} losses).
lines.chat.fact.rival_king: You are the King of the street: the one everybody wants to beat.
lines.chat.fact.rival_grudge: The player won your {car} from you on pink slips. You want it back: you want a rematch.
lines.chat.fact.rival_broke: You are broke right now and need money.
lines.chat.fact.no_races: You have never raced the player.
lines.chat.fact.races: You have raced the player {count} times: you won {won}, the player won {lost}. The latest:
lines.chat.fact.no_memories: You do not remember ever talking to the player (you never did, or you have forgotten).
lines.chat.fact.memories: What you remember of talking to the player before:
lines.chat.fact.feeling.sore: You are sore at the player and it shows: short with them, a jab or two. It changes how you talk, never a price.
lines.chat.fact.feeling.cool: You are a little cool toward the player: polite enough, not warm. It changes how you talk, never a price.
lines.chat.fact.feeling.warm: You like the player well enough: easy and friendly with them. It changes how you talk, never a price.
lines.chat.fact.feeling.friendly: You think a lot of the player: glad to see them, on their side. It changes how you talk, never a price.
lines.chat.fact.events: What happened between you and the player, as it truly was:
lines.chat.fact.event.bought: - {when}: the player bought the {what} from you for {amount:money}.
lines.chat.fact.event.sold: - {when}: the player sold you their {what} for {amount:money}.
lines.chat.fact.event.offered: - {when}: the player offered {amount:money} for the {what}; no deal was made.
lines.chat.fact.event.asked: - {when}: the player asked {amount:money} for their {what}; no deal was made.
lines.chat.fact.event.insulted: - {when}: the player insulted you over the {what}, with an offer far too low or a price far too high.
lines.chat.fact.event.beaten: - {when}: the player beat you in a race.
lines.chat.fact.event.beat_player: - {when}: you beat the player in a race.
lines.chat.fact.event.pink_lost: - {when}: the player won your car off you for pink slips.
lines.chat.fact.event.pink_won: - {when}: you won the player's car for pink slips.
lines.chat.fact.said: What you already said about this one (do not say it again; say something new):
lines.chat.fact.price: The price is {price:money}. Never name a lower price yourself: only the deal lines below change it.
lines.chat.fact.price_down: You first asked {asked:money}; you have come down to {price:money}. Never name a lower price yourself: only the deal lines below change it.
lines.chat.deal.accept: The player has just offered {offer:money}. You take it: the price is now {price:money}. Say yes, it's a deal.
lines.chat.deal.accept_asked: The player has just offered {offer:money}, which is MORE than your price of {price:money}: they are not haggling you down. Glad of it, and honest, you take only your price, {price:money}: say it's a deal at {price:money}.
lines.chat.deal.counter: The player has just offered {offer:money}. Too low, but you come down to {price:money} and no lower right now. Say so.
lines.chat.deal.firm: The player has just offered {offer:money}. You will not come down any more from {price:money}. Say so.
lines.chat.deal.shake: The player takes your price, {price:money}: it's a deal. Shake on it at {price:money}, not a cent lower.
lines.chat.deal.held: The price is {price:money}, friend. That's as low as it goes.
lines.chat.fact.price_warning: You just named a price lower than {price:money} by yourself: never do that. The price is {price:money}; only the deal lines change it.
lines.chat.deal.insulted: The player has just offered {offer:money}: far too low, near an insult. Turn it down; the price stays {price:money}.
lines.chat.fact.offer: You have offered {price:money} for it. Never offer more yourself: only the deal lines below change it.
lines.chat.fact.offer_up: You first offered {asked:money}; you have come up to {price:money}. Never offer more yourself: only the deal lines below change it.
lines.chat.fact.offer_gone: You have walked away from this deal: you no longer want the car. Say so if it comes up, politely or not.
lines.chat.fact.offer_warning: You just offered more than {price:money} by yourself: never do that. Your offer is {price:money}; only the deal lines change it.
lines.chat.deal.buyer.accept: The player has just asked {offer:money}. You agree: your offer is now {price:money}. Say yes, it's a deal.
lines.chat.deal.buyer.accept_offered: The player has just asked {offer:money}, LESS than the {price:money} you offered. Glad of it, and honest, you keep to your offer of {price:money}: say it's a deal at {price:money}.
lines.chat.deal.buyer.counter: The player has just asked {offer:money}. Too much, but you come up to {price:money} and no higher right now. Say so.
lines.chat.deal.buyer.firm: The player has just asked {offer:money}. You will not go any higher than {price:money}. Say so.
lines.chat.deal.buyer.shake: The player takes your offer, {price:money}: it's a deal. Shake on it at {price:money}, not a cent more.
lines.chat.deal.buyer.walk: The player has just asked {offer:money}: too much, and you have had enough. You no longer want the car: say so and say goodbye.
lines.chat.deal.buyer.held: I said {price:money}, and that's all I've got.
lines.chat.ui.hint: Ask about it, or name your price...
lines.chat.ui.dead_line: The line went dead. Try again.
